summary: The strip is a clean, steady drift with no pops or flicker, but the comet and the "boo" burst are not visible yet and the small dark figure barely reads.

faults.what: The shot idea is a comet tail and something bursting out at his face. In these 6 frames of the shot there is no comet, tail or second character, only a tiny figure drifting past stars. The idea does not read at the start.
faults.fix: Bring the comet tail into frame from the first frame, or open just before the reveal so the burst lands in view.

faults.what: The figure is very small and dark against a dark background. The silhouette barely reads, and the planet at top left draws the eye more than he does.
faults.fix: Push the camera in or scale him up, and add a rim light so the pose reads.

faults.what: The pose is almost frozen across all 8 tiles, with a stiff outstretched arm and legs and little secondary motion. It looks like a static cutout sliding.
faults.fix: Add a slow limb sway or slight rotation to the drift.
